claims.statement: For the ordinary nearest-neighbor hard-core model on Z^2 there are multiple Gibbs measures for every lambda > 5.3343. More precisely, mu_taxi <= 158644042/100000000, and coexistence holds for every lambda > (158644042/100000000)^4-1 = 33339050267648037954014268362481/6250000000000000000000000000000.

Published taxi-walk counts through length 60, analyzed by stride-four ratio fits and exact-coefficient differential approximants, numerically suggest mu_taxi about 1.574 and hence a limiting taxi-counting threshold about 5.14. The five differential-approximant estimates range from mu=1.57364176 to 1.57381500; this spread is not a rigorous error interval.

For every finite W subset Z^2 whose edge-boundary interior endpoints are all even, each of the four sets F_s={v in W: v-s not in W} has size |W_even|-|W_odd|=|edge boundary W|/4. Thus choosing the best of the four single-unit shifts of the published contour interior cannot improve the (1+lambda)^(|Gamma|/4) gain.

A normalized open taxi decision word whose visited ORIGINAL-grid midpoint edges cut off a finite component and include an extra edge off that component's boundary cannot occur in the midpoint contour of Section 3.1 of Blanca-Chen-Galvin-Randall-Tetali. The prohibition holds at every start parity and either first axis, because the full affine taxi symmetries preserve the original grid. Forty-five such universal words through 16 edges have exact finite cut witnesses.

For the ordinary nearest-neighbor hard-core model on Z^2 there are distinct even and odd infinite-volume Gibbs measures at every uniform activity lambda >522254932298171554190498563203521/100000000000000000000000000000000 = (157939983/100000000)^4-1. In particular lambda >5.2226 suffices. The rate 1.57939983 is for the restricted contour-word language, not the whole taxi connective constant.

For the specific 9347538-state filtered/root-reachable contour counting matrix defined by manifest SHA256 8f1317423030d6f50ec39cac2c5969842b61c98b423f4ed25fef4a08c32cd7eb, the root count A_k=e_root M^k 1 is at least (157948493/100000000)^k at every k>=0. Thus no finite-C all-length A_k<=C r^k certificate for this matrix can have r<1.57948493; the fixed r^4-1 Peierls cutoff cannot be below exact 5.223890545735260... . This is not a lower bound on actual contour growth or the physical critical activity.
